source: Expected outcomes written by hand from each issue's text and recording.
note: Spot-checked issues are kept here, so the held-out set stays unseen. 9509, 12405 and 9938 did not reproduce at the pin on 2026-11-24 and serve as negative tuning cases.

entries.bug: Switching tool while drawing an arrow places the arrow instead of cancelling it
steps: Select the arrow tool
Click a start point and a second point
Switch to the selection tool or another tool before finishing
entries.wrong_result: The arrow tool breaks; the unfinished arrow is placed down
entries.expected_result: Switching tool cancels or cleanly finishes the arrow

entries.bug: Deselecting one group from a multi-group selection turns the other groups into individual elements
steps: Create several groups
Box-select all of them
Shift-click one group to deselect it
entries.wrong_result: The remaining groups become individually selected elements; aligning shows the state is wrong
entries.expected_result: The remaining groups stay selected as groups

entries.bug: Axis lock shifts a copied element vertically
steps: Create an element
Hold Alt and drag it to make a copy
Release Alt and hold Shift while still dragging
entries.wrong_result: The new element is sometimes shifted vertically
entries.expected_result: The copy keeps the identical vertical or horizontal position

entries.bug: The hex code popover covers the Preferences submenu
steps: Open the main menu
Open Preferences
Under Canvas background, open the custom colour hex input
entries.wrong_result: The popover covers Preferences items such as Zen mode and View mode
entries.expected_result: The popover does not hide the menu items

entries.bug: Ȳ and ȳ are not rendered on the canvas
steps: Create a text element
Type Ȳ ȳ
Finish editing
entries.wrong_result: The glyphs show in the editor but not on the canvas
entries.expected_result: The canvas shows the same glyphs as the editor

entries.bug: S then B in the draw tool switches to bucket fill instead of picking red
steps: Select the draw tool
Press S to open the colour palette
Press B to pick red
entries.wrong_result: The bucket fill tool is selected
entries.expected_result: Red becomes the active colour and the draw tool stays active

entries.bug: Wrapping several coloured texts gives every container the same colour
steps: Create text elements with different stroke colours
Select all
Use Wrap text in a container
entries.wrong_result: All containers use the same colour
entries.expected_result: Each container matches its own text colour

entries.bug: Colour swatch spacing is wrong for some multi-selections
steps: Draw a rectangle, a diamond and a line
Select more than one of them or group them
Look at the stroke and background swatches
entries.expected_result: Swatches keep their normal spacing, as for circles, arrows, drawings and text
